description: This file defines the EntityEcaReader class, which models the <entity-eca-reader> XML element within the Apache OFBiz framework. It parses XML configuration to extract the name attribute and associated resource elements, providing accessors for these properties.

classes.name: EntityEcaReader
classes.description: Models the <entity-eca-reader> XML element, manages its resource list, and provides access to its properties.

methods.name: EntityEcaReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object by parsing the provided XML element, extracting the 'name' attribute and resources.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the value of the 'name' attribute.

methods.name: getResourceList
methods.description: Returns the list of resource elements associated with this reader.
